title: "IPCEI DiD --- sensitivity: anticipation windows and HonestDiD"
output: html_document
---

```{r setup, include=FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo = TRUE, warning = FALSE, message = FALSE)
library(did); library(dplyr)
source("_cs_helpers.R")
set.seed(42)
```

Two sensitivity analyses on the primary (PSM balance) panels, kept out of
`07_..._psm.Rmd` so the main results files are never overwritten.

1. **Anticipation windows.** The treatment date is formal Commission approval.
   `anticipation = k` tells C&S to treat the `k` periods before `g` as already
   treated, so identification shifts to earlier pre-periods. Battery has only
   12 pre-treatment months (panel starts 2020-01, single cohort 2021-01), so
   `k = 6` leaves too little pre-window and is not run for battery.
2. **HonestDiD.** Relaxes exact parallel trends, reporting the largest violation
   (`Mbar`, relative to the worst pre-treatment violation) under which the
   effect remains distinguishable from zero.

Outputs go to `results/psm/sensitivity/`; nothing here writes to the main
`composition_techtagged/` or `intensity/` folders.

```{r flags}
RUN_HONESTDID <- FALSE   # dropped from the paper, see DRAFT_EDITS.md issue M
```

```{r paths}
OUT_DIR <- "../results/psm/sensitivity"
dir.create(OUT_DIR, showWarnings = FALSE, recursive = TRUE)

PANELS <- list(Battery  = "../data/battery_psm_spec1_cs_ready.csv",
               Hydrogen = "../data/hydrogen_psm_spec1_cs_ready.csv")

# Confirmatory family only: the three outcomes the scheme's conditions target.
OUTCOMES <- c(tech_focused = "Technology-related",
              cross_border = "Cross-border EU",
              cross_sector = "Cross-sector")

ANTICIPATION <- c(0, 3, 6)
MAX_ANTIC <- c(Battery = 3, Hydrogen = 6)   # battery pre-window caps at 3
```

```{r load}
panels <- lapply(PANELS, load_cs)
for (tech in names(panels)) {
  df <- panels[[tech]]
  g  <- unique(df$g_period[df$g_period > 0])
  cat(sprintf("%-9s periods %d..%d | cohorts at %s | pre-periods before first cohort: %d\n",
              tech, min(df$period), max(df$period),
              paste(sort(g), collapse = ", "), min(g) - min(df$period)))
}
```

# 1. Anticipation windows

```{r anticipation}
rows <- list()
for (tech in names(panels)) {
  df <- panels[[tech]]
  for (k in ANTICIPATION) {
    if (k > MAX_ANTIC[[tech]]) {
      cat(sprintf("skip %s k=%d (pre-window too short)\n", tech, k)); next
    }
    for (key in names(OUTCOMES)) {
      y <- outcome_map[[key]][[tolower(tech)]]
      if (!(y %in% names(df))) next
      cs <- run_cs(df, y, label = sprintf("%s %s anticipation=%d", tech, key, k),
                   control_group = cg_for(tolower(tech)),
                   anticipation = k)
      if (is.null(cs)) next
      r <- make_att_row_std(agg_simple(cs), tech, OUTCOMES[[key]],
                            sprintf("anticipation=%d", k),
                            cs_out = cs, df = df, yname = y)
      r$anticipation <- k
      rows[[paste(tech, key, k)]] <- r
    }
  }
}
antic <- do.call(rbind, rows)
write.csv(antic, file.path(OUT_DIR, "att_anticipation.csv"), row.names = FALSE)
print(antic[, c("Technology", "Outcome", "anticipation", "ATT", "SE",
                "p_value", "pretrend_p_value", "N_treated")], row.names = FALSE)
```

# 2. HonestDiD

`honest_did()` for C&S objects is distributed with HonestDiD; it takes the
event-study aggregation and returns the robust confidence set for a given
`Mbar`. The breakdown value is the largest `Mbar` at which the effect is still
distinguishable from zero.

```{r honestdid, eval = RUN_HONESTDID && requireNamespace("HonestDiD", quietly = TRUE)}
library(HonestDiD)

# Event-study vcov from the C&S influence function, as in the HonestDiD
# vignette for Callaway-Sant'Anna objects: V = t(inf) %*% inf / n / n.
# l_vec averages over the post-treatment path, so the target matches the
# reported overall effect rather than a single event month.
hd_rows <- list()
for (tech in names(panels)) {
  df <- panels[[tech]]
  for (key in names(OUTCOMES)) {
    y <- outcome_map[[key]][[tolower(tech)]]
    if (!(y %in% names(df))) next
    cs <- run_cs(df, y, label = paste(tech, key, "(HonestDiD)"),
                 control_group = cg_for(tolower(tech)), biters = 999)
    if (is.null(cs)) next
    es <- tryCatch(aggte(cs, type = "dynamic", min_e = -6, max_e = 12,
                         bstrap = TRUE, cband = TRUE),
                   error = function(e) NULL)
    if (is.null(es)) next
    inf <- es$inf.function$dynamic.inf.func.e
    n   <- nrow(inf)
    V   <- t(inf) %*% inf / n / n
    npre <- sum(es$egt < 0); npost <- sum(es$egt >= 0)
    if (npre < 2 || npost < 1) { cat("   too few periods, skipping\n"); next }
    res <- tryCatch(
      createSensitivityResults_relativeMagnitudes(
        betahat = es$att.egt, sigma = V,
        numPrePeriods = npre, numPostPeriods = npost,
        l_vec   = rep(1 / npost, npost),
        Mbarvec = seq(0.25, 2, by = 0.25)),
      error = function(e) { cat("   HonestDiD failed:", conditionMessage(e), "\n"); NULL })
    if (is.null(res)) next
    res$Technology <- tech; res$Outcome <- OUTCOMES[[key]]
    hd_rows[[paste(tech, key)]] <- res
  }
}

if (length(hd_rows)) {
  hd <- do.call(rbind, hd_rows)
  write.csv(hd, file.path(OUT_DIR, "honestdid_relative_magnitudes.csv"), row.names = FALSE)
  print(as.data.frame(hd), row.names = FALSE)
  # Breakdown Mbar: largest Mbar at which the robust CI still excludes zero.
  brk <- hd %>%
    group_by(Technology, Outcome) %>%
    summarise(breakdown_Mbar = if (any(lb > 0 | ub < 0))
                max(Mbar[lb > 0 | ub < 0]) else NA_real_, .groups = "drop")
  cat("\n-- Breakdown Mbar (largest violation tolerated) --\n")
  print(as.data.frame(brk), row.names = FALSE)
  write.csv(brk, file.path(OUT_DIR, "honestdid_breakdown.csv"), row.names = FALSE)
} else {
  cat("No HonestDiD results produced.\n")
}
```
